limitations: Fixed four-token context, no tokenizer or generation loop
Embedding selection uses explicit host file slices; addition runs on GPU
Activations and complete logits cross host transport
Block and head weights are reread each pass; six graphs use a four-model LRU
Native memory counters exclude separate JavaScript/WebView processes
Android shared native cache also served app UI graphs during profiling
Android profile replays are additional to worker execution; not a throughput benchmark
